description: A founder needs to organize emails, invoices, milestone notes, and timeline details into a coherent factual record before meeting legal counsel about a deteriorating client relationship.

user_profile.persona: 32-year-old startup founder with messy documentation habits
user_profile.context: The facts exist, but they are scattered across tools and hard to narrate cleanly
user_profile.communication_style: Fast-moving but willing to slow down if it improves clarity

fact_sheet.fact: The Master Services Agreement (MSA) between Innovatech Solutions LLC and Global Retail Corp was signed on January 15, 2023.
Statement of Work SOW-004, titled 'Project Omni E-commerce Platform', was attached to the MSA, with a total value of $250,000.
The payment terms specified in SOW-004 are Net 30 upon completion and approval of each of the four milestones.
Mark Chen, Head of Digital Transformation at Global Retail Corp, is listed as the primary client contact in the MSA.
The contract includes a clause for a 1.5% monthly interest penalty on overdue invoices.
Milestone 1, 'Discovery & Technical Scoping', was completed and signed off by Global Retail Corp on February 15, 2023.
Milestone 2, 'UI/UX Wireframes & Design Approval', was delivered on March 31, 2023, but client approval was delayed until April 20, 2023.
Milestone 3, 'Backend Development & API Delivery', was completed and delivered by Innovatech Solutions on May 30, 2023.
Global Retail Corp has not provided formal sign-off for Milestone 3 as of August 18, 2023.
Work on Milestone 4, 'Frontend & Systems Integration', is currently blocked pending client feedback on the API endpoints delivered in Milestone 3.
Invoice #INV-1001 for Milestone 1 ($50,000) was issued on February 16, 2023, and paid in full on March 10, 2023.
Invoice #INV-1002 for Milestone 2 ($75,000) was issued on April 21, 2023, and paid in full on May 25, 2023.
Invoice #INV-1003 for Milestone 3 ($75,000) was issued on May 31, 2023, and is currently 79 days overdue.
The total amount invoiced to Global Retail Corp to date is $200,000.
The total amount paid by Global Retail Corp to date is $125,000.
The current outstanding balance owed by Global Retail Corp is $75,000, excluding any late fees.
On June 5, 2023, Mark Chen requested a change from 'real-time inventory sync' to 'batch inventory sync every 15 minutes' via email, which was accepted by Innovatech Solutions.
On June 12, 2023, Mark Chen requested the addition of a 'customer loyalty points system' via email, which was not in the original SOW.
Innovatech Solutions submitted Change Request CR-001 for the loyalty system, with a cost of $25,000, on June 14, 2023; Global Retail Corp never signed or responded to the document.
The shared Slack channel for daily project communication is #proj-omni-grc.
An email from Mark Chen on August 5, 2023, with the subject 'Regarding Invoice INV-1003', stated an intent to withhold payment due to 'unacceptable project delays'.
The original project launch date per SOW-004 was September 30, 2023.
Global Retail Corp missed the 5-business-day feedback deadline for the API schema in July 2023 by an additional 12 business days.
The project's staging server, hosted at staging.omni.innovatech.dev, was inaccessible for 48 hours (July 19-21, 2023) due to a firewall misconfiguration on the client's network.
Global Retail Corp's primary subject matter expert for logistics was unavailable for three scheduled weekly check-in meetings on July 7, July 14, and July 28, 2023.
Innovatech Solutions' project management tool (Jira) shows that 85% of the logged project delays are attributed to 'Waiting for Client Feedback'.
The founder, Jian Li, is the sole proprietor of Innovatech Solutions LLC.
Jian Li has scheduled a consultation with Sarah Miller of the law firm Sterling & Wright LLP.
The legal consultation is scheduled for August 25, 2023, at 2:00 PM EST via video conference.
The stated purpose of the meeting is to discuss options for contract enforcement, payment collection, and potential termination of the agreement with Global Retail Corp.

What is the total amount invoiced and the total amount paid to date by Global Retail Corp?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After seeing an outstanding balance, the user will want to confirm the overall financial totals for context.

user_needs.description: Which project milestone is associated with the overdue invoice INV-1003, and when was it delivered?
Has Global Retail Corp provided formal sign-off for Milestone 3?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Knowing a milestone was delivered but the invoice is unpaid leads directly to questioning the approval status.

user_needs.description: What was the client's stated reason for withholding payment on invoice INV-1003?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After establishing that a milestone was delivered but not signed off, the user's next logical step is to find any communication from the client explaining why.

user_needs.description: What is the primary cause of project delays according to the project management tool?
By how many business days did the client miss the feedback deadline for the API schema in July?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After seeing a general statement about client feedback causing delays, the user would want a specific, quantifiable example.

user_needs.description: Is there a penalty for overdue invoices specified in the contract?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once the client's refusal to pay is established, the user will want to know what contractual remedies are available, such as late fees.

user_needs.description: Did the client request a 'customer loyalty points system' and was a formal Change Request submitted for it?
Who am I meeting with for the legal consultation and when is it scheduled?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing the contractual basis for penalties, the user's focus shifts to the upcoming legal meeting where these facts will be discussed, making the meeting details relevant.
